title: Relax pristine C₂N geometry
action: Perform geometry relaxation of monolayer C₂N using Quantum ESPRESSO with PBE functional. Relax atomic positions and cell until forces converge.
description: Obtain ground‑state geometry of pristine monolayer C₂N.

title: Relax B‑doped C₂N geometry
action: Construct a cell with one N substituted by B, relax geometry using PBE.
description: Obtain relaxed geometry of B‑doped C₂N (B on N site).

title: Relax P‑doped C₂N geometry
action: Construct a cell with one N substituted by P, relax geometry using PBE.
description: Obtain relaxed geometry of P‑doped C₂N (P on N site).

title: Compute band edges of pristine C₂N
action: Using relaxed pristine structure, run HSE06 static calculation. Extract band gap, absolute CBM (vacuum), VBM (vacuum) via vacuum alignment.
description: Scored JSON: HSE06 band gap, CBM_vacuum, VBM_vacuum for pristine monolayer C₂N.

title: Compute band edges of B‑doped C₂N
action: From relaxed B‑doped geometry, run HSE06 static calculation, extract band gap, CBM_vacuum, VBM_vacuum.
description: Scored JSON: HSE06 band properties for B‑doped C₂N.

title: Compute band edges of P‑doped C₂N
action: From relaxed P‑doped geometry, run HSE06 static calculation, extract band gap, CBM_vacuum, VBM_vacuum.
description: Scored JSON: HSE06 band properties for P‑doped C₂N.
